title: Emerging Markets: Catalyst, but Follow Through?

assessment: The Microsoft vote, bitcoin breakout and twelve-month direction were concrete successes. Debt-ceiling cash drainage also occurred, including under the supposedly less contentious Trump scenario. Emerging-market analysis was appropriately conditional but does not justify a precise hit rate; illustrative JD probabilities must never be mistaken for forecasts.
